nodes.label: Watch Debounce

nodes.label: Code-Only Update Skip Semantic

nodes.label: No API Key Required
nodes.rationale: graphify never asks for or blocks on an API key. Gemini is used only if GEMINI_API_KEY/GOOGLE_API_KEY is already set; otherwise the host agent is the LLM. ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and OPENAI_API_KEY are not read.

nodes.label: Graph Health Check
nodes.rationale: Read-only integrity gate before labeling; surfaces dangling endpoints, self-loops, and collapsed edges without aborting so silent incremental corruption stays visible.

nodes.label: Confidence Rubric
nodes.rationale: Discrete scores (1.0 EXTRACTED; INFERRED 0.95/0.85/0.75/0.65/0.55; AMBIGUOUS 0.1-0.3) because production models collapsed a continuous range to a bimodal 0.5 vs 0.85+ distribution.

nodes.label: Honesty Rules
nodes.rationale: Never invent an edge (use AMBIGUOUS if unsure); never skip the corpus-size warning; always show token cost and raw cohesion numbers; never run HTML viz on >5000 nodes without warning.

nodes.label: Per-Subfolder Extract
nodes.rationale: The skill pipeline writes all outputs to cwd graphify-out/, so running the skill on each subfolder would clobber the same dir; CLI extract places graphify-out inside each scanned path instead.

nodes.label: Post-Commit Hook
